description:
A strange interview of Jim Carrey has sparked a viral conspiracy that the legendary actor may have been replaced by a clone or body double. Then an artist posted a mask he allegedly created for Jim Carrey, giving more fuel to the conspiracy. And now that technology and misinformation blur reality, the bigger question might be whether we can trust anything we see anymore.
